C-CLI-JSON-PIN-SYNC.IntentSummary: Superseded by C-CLI-JSON-PIN-SYNC-R1: the baseline README anchor did not match the shipped wording. Original intent: mirror the proven opencode.json pin flow onto the global cli.json: a new cli-plugin-registration module reuses the managed-entry normalization with comment-preserving JSONC edits, install, init, and sync call it beside ensurePackageInstalled (upgrade inherits via sync), inspection exposes the cli pin with a mismatch flag, and doctor and status print it with stale-pin warnings. Two tasks: the writer and command wiring with tests, then inspection surfaces, README, GRACE projections, and the full gates. Approved by explicit user instruction; execution has not started.

PlanningNotes.Note: Approval provenance: the user approved the design in conversation (fix upgrade/install/sync to keep the cli.json pin current and teach doctor/status to show both pins) and said to proceed; spec and plan are approved, execution has not started.
Pre-plan preflight: grace lint --path . passes with 0 errors after the spec bundle was created; no observed writes to source have begun.

Implementation shape: cli.json is addressed only through the global OpenCode config home resolved next to the existing paths; the writer reuses normalizePluginEntries and isManagedPackageTarget from plugin-registration, so the module imports must stay one-directional (cli module imports plugin-registration, never the reverse) to avoid a cycle; callers in install, init, and sync invoke it beside ensurePackageInstalled.
Pure pin comparison lives in the cli module and is unit-tested; inspection calls it, so mismatch semantics are covered without spawning a host.
No final-review obligation is declared by the source; GRACE lifecycle commands stay external and never nest inside a MustPassCommand.
Execution entrypoint is grace-execute in sequential mode.

T-001.Title: Add the cli.json pin writer and wire install, init, and sync.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Resolve the global cli.json path in ResolvedPaths (global config home with the config-dir override) and expose it as cliConfigPath.

ensureCliPackageConfigText rewrites a managed string or object entry to the requested specifier preserving options, unrelated entries, order, comments, and unrelated keys; appends a managed entry when plugins exists without one; creates a minimal document with the cli schema URL and the pinned entry when text is absent; refuses conflicting managed entries with an explicit error; repeated runs are byte-stable.

ensureCliPackageInstalled writes through the same writeText path as the opencode.json pin and returns path plus changed; src/lib/opencode.ts re-exports the new functions; imports stay one-directional with plugin-registration.
install, init, and sync call ensureCliPackageInstalled beside ensurePackageInstalled and print the cli.json write with an updated-or-kept status.

Unit tests cover rewrite, options preservation, append, fresh creation, idempotency, conflict refusal, and the pure pin comparison; module contracts, maps, and change summaries are updated in every touched file.

T-002.Title: Surface both pins in inspection, doctor, and status; sync docs and gates.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Installation inspection reads cli.json through the pure helper, reports path, existence, parse state, managed pin, and mismatch against the opencode.json managed pin, and pushes the stale-or-missing warning naming both pins and vvoc sync; parse failures surface as bounded diagnostics without guessing.
doctor and status print a TUI client pin line sourced from the inspection result in every scope.
README documents the server pin in opencode.json, the TUI client pin in cli.json, the host migration origin, and the doctor line.

Update M-CLI-CONFIG and M-CLI-COMMANDS graph purposes and their verification scenarios for the cli pin flow; run bun run check, bun run build, and grace lint with fresh output; no unrelated files change.
